name: Cache Rebuild Performance Monitor
description: Monitors filetree cache rebuild performance and detects slow rebuilds

scenarios.description: Full flow from file change to UI render - the complete success path

template.introduction:
**Complete FileTree Synchronization**

Successfully synchronized file tree from file system change to UI update.

Repository: `{{repository.path}}`
Total files: {{filetree.files_count}}

events.filetree.workspace.changed: [4] workspace:changed IPC event fired for `{{repository.path}}` at {{event.timestamp}}
events.filetree.cache.invalidated: [5] Cache invalidated for `{{repository.path}}` (was v{{cache.version.before}}, rebuild scheduled: {{cache.rebuild.scheduled}})
events.filetree.cache.rebuild: [7] Cache rebuilt for `{{repository.path}}` in {{cache.rebuild.duration_ms}}ms -> v{{cache.version.after}} ({{filetree.files_count}} files)
events.filetree.cache.synced: [8] CACHE_SYNC event sent for `{{repository.path}}` (v{{cache.version.after}}, slice: {{cache.slice}}, {{event.payload.size_bytes}} bytes)

scenarios.description: User or system triggered manual cache refresh (bypasses debounce)

events.filetree.cache.invalidated: [2] Cache invalidated for `{{repository.path}}` immediately (no debounce, was v{{cache.version.before}}, rebuild scheduled: {{cache.rebuild.scheduled}})
events.filetree.cache.rebuild: [3] Cache rebuilt for `{{repository.path}}` in {{cache.rebuild.duration_ms}}ms -> v{{cache.version.after}} ({{filetree.files_count}} files)

- Repository: `{{repository.path}}`
